title: Tower category has enough injectives
statement: The abelian category [lem-pc-tower-abelian] of inverse systems of abelian groups indexed by the natural numbers has enough injective objects [def-sp-enough-injectives].

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-tower-injective-embedding] to an arbitrary tower A to obtain a monomorphism into a tower I of injective groups with split-surjective transitions. Apply [lem-pc-injective-split-tower-injective] to these properties to obtain injectivity of I in the tower category. Package I and the monomorphism as an injective presentation of A. Doing this for every A gives enough injectives [def-sp-enough-injectives].
